text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki's running captivated the 
crowd. At the press conference that 
followed, she declared her ambition to 
become a "Triple Crown Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki fires up the crowd with her 
passionate words. With expectations 
soaring, her next challenge is the Asahi 
Hai FS.
